audit_objective: Root cause investigation of recorded low test recall (Micro-Recall: 0.0094, Micro-F1: 0.0185)

unrepresented_in_train_0.explanation: No positive training examples in 10% subset. Logits never received positive gradients.

rare_1_to_9.explanation: Weak positive signals overwhelmed by 67,700+ negative updates per epoch.

medium_10_to_99.explanation: Moderate positive signals; most logits peaked between -3.0 and -1.0 (p = 0.05 to 0.27).

common_ge_100.explanation: High support allowed linear head to learn strong positive weights, but tau=0.5 still clipped lower-confidence provisions.

step5_validation_threshold_analysis.selection_procedure: Maximized Micro-F1 strictly on validation partition without test exposure

step6_controlled_recommendation.primary_root_cause: Extreme Class Imbalance (10,500:1 negative-to-positive ratio) trained under standard unweighted BCE loss (pos_weight=None) with arbitrary threshold 0.50.
step6_controlled_recommendation.mechanics_explanation: With 12,608 classes and ~1.19 positive labels per provision, 99.99% of gradient updates push the logits negative. The linear classification head naturally learns large negative biases (prior log-odds ≈ -9.27). Output probabilities σ(z) are heavily concentrated in [0.0001, 0.05]. The rigid threshold of 0.50 requires logit z > 0, which truncates 99.06% of true positives. When probabilities exceed 0.50, the model is highly confident (Micro-Precision: 69.75%), but recall is crippled (0.94%).

recommendation_rank_1.intervention: Validation-Calibrated Threshold Tuning (Post-Processing, Zero Retraining Cost)
recommendation_rank_1.action: Select optimal threshold τ* ∈ [0.05, 0.10] on the validation partition to recover recall without retraining.
recommendation_rank_1.projected_gain: Micro-Recall increases from 0.0094 to 0.25–0.38; Micro-F1 increases from 0.0185 to 0.30–0.45.

recommendation_rank_2.intervention: Loss Function Class Weighting (Next Retraining Run)
recommendation_rank_2.action: Configure BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=...) with bounded positive class weights (e.g., pos_weight=20.0 or inverse-frequency capped).
recommendation_rank_2.rationale: Directly counteracts the 10,500:1 negative gradient overwhelming during gradient descent.

investigations_rejected.name: Learning Rate
investigations_rejected.verdict: REJECTED as primary cause. lr=0.001 is standard for AdamW with a frozen encoder. Changing lr alone does not fix the 10,500:1 gradient imbalance.

investigations_rejected.name: Label Mapping Bug
investigations_rejected.verdict: REJECTED. Exhaustively audited. Label2id mapping, tensor indexing, and collator are strictly identical across train, val, and test.

investigations_rejected.name: Training Duration
investigations_rejected.verdict: REJECTED as primary cause. More epochs under unweighted BCE will simply push rare logits even deeper into the negative regime.
